scope: Independent visual source review of six B/C pose sheets generated by root. Illustration pilot only; not professional biomechanics or commercial-machine certification.

standing-machine-calf-raise.verdict: usable pilot source with limited visible body range
standing-machine-calf-raise.observed: Forefeet remain supported, heels lift progressively, knees remain nearly extended without obvious squat/pumping. The yoke, shoulders/waist/thighs show a small upward movement; body is not entirely frozen while only ankles change. Loaded stack rises. Fixed outer frame/base remains recognizable.
standing-machine-calf-raise.limitation: The rendered whole-body/yoke range is modest and there is some neck/surface drift. Do not treat the generated mechanism as an exact kinematic simulation.
standing-machine-calf-raise.watch: Register the fixed base/platform, not the head, body, yoke or moving weight block; inspect foot-platform contacts after interpolation.

stair-calf-raise.watch: Do not register on head/heels; use lower fixed stair/rail structure. Inspect both heels and toe support.

dumbbell-lying-triceps-extension.verdict: usable after omitting abrupt final cell
dumbbell-lying-triceps-extension.observed: Cells0–7 show progressive elbow flexion with upper arms relatively stable and dumbbells approaching beside/above the head without visible impact. Cell7 already reaches approximately a right-angle elbow bend and is suitable as the lowered endpoint.
dumbbell-lying-triceps-extension.rejectedReason: Cell8 abruptly turns the dumbbell/grip axes about90degrees compared with the preceding cells. Including it would imply a sudden wrist/grip rotation unrelated to the exercise.
dumbbell-lying-triceps-extension.assemblyRecommendation: Use eight anchors0..7 with progress normalized0..1; preserve original sheet, omit cell8 from interpolation. No new generation necessary.
dumbbell-lying-triceps-extension.watch: Maintain head/weight clearance and both elbows/weights through the flexion arc; check small wrist changes after interpolation.

bench-dip.observed: Hands remain on the bench, feet flat with bent knees, hips descend close to the bench and elbows flex behind the body. No obvious extra limb or loss of the bench/foot contact in source poses.
bench-dip.watch: Use bench leg/base as fixed reference, not moving torso; inspect both wrist contacts and the lower position.
